attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Arkansas state income tax calculation. Implements progressive tax structure per AR tax code (2025). Top rate reduced from 4.4% to 3.9% effective 1/1/2025.

condition_details.condition_comment: Head of Household or Surviving Spouse: one extra personal credit
condition_details.condition_dsl: job.filing_status is equal to "HOH" or job.filing_status is equal to "QSS"
condition_details.condition_postfix: job.filing_status "HOH" streq { pop job.filing_status "QSS" streq } over not if

action_details.action_comment: AR1000F line 7A: HOH or Surviving Spouse box
Line 28 net taxable income; line 29 tax from the Regular Tax Table
action_details.action_dsl: set result.ar_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.state_calc_agi - result.ar_std_deduction) and 0.0; perform AR_Tax_Table
action_details.action_postfix: result.state_calc_agi result.ar_std_deduction f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.ar_taxable_income xdef /AR_Tax_Table performtable

action_details.action_dsl: set result.ar_personal_credits = (length of job.taxpayers + length of job.dependents + result.senior_std_count + result.ar_extra_credits) * ar_personal_tax_credit
action_details.action_postfix: job.taxpayers length job.dependents length + result.senior_std_count + result.ar_extra_credits f+ ar_personal_tax_credit fmul cvd /result.ar_personal_credits xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set result.ar_state_tax = the maximum of (result.ar_table_tax - result.ar_personal_credits) and 0.0
action_details.action_postfix: result.ar_table_tax result.ar_personal_credits f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.ar_state_tax xdef

action_details.action_comment: Harvested onto the roster by Compute_Roster_State_Tax
action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = result.ar_taxable_income; set result.computed_state_tax = result.ar_state_tax
action_details.action_postfix: result.ar_taxable_income cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.ar_state_tax cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef

action_details.action_dsl: add " Arkansas (AR1000F 2025): net taxable income $" + result.ar_taxable_income + ", table tax $" + result.ar_table_tax + ", personal credits $" + result.ar_personal_credits + ", tax $" + result.ar_state_tax to job.audit_trail
action_details.action_postfix: " Arkansas (AR1000F 2025): net taxable income $" result.ar_taxable_income strconcat ", table tax $" strconcat result.ar_table_tax strconcat ", personal credits $" strconcat result.ar_personal_credits strconcat ", tax $" strconcat result.ar_state_tax strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Arkansas military retirement income exclusion. Provides 100% exclusion for military retirement pay and SBP payments. Honors MSRRA (spouse income exempt if different domicile) and SCRA (active duty pay exempt if different state of residence). Per AR Code § 26-51-426 (2025).

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: if result.ar_taxable_income >= ar_table_band_shift then { set result.ar_band_midpoint = (the floor of ((result.ar_taxable_income - 1.0) / 100.0)) * 100.0 + 51.0; } else { set result.ar_band_midpoint = (the floor of (result.ar_taxable_income / 100.0)) * 100.0 + 50.0; } endif
initial_action.initial_action_postfix: { result.ar_taxable_income 1.0 f- 100.0 fdiv floor 100.0 fmul 51.0 f+ cvd /result.ar_band_midpoint xdef } { result.ar_taxable_income 100.0 fdiv floor 100.0 fmul 50.0 f+ cvd /result.ar_band_midpoint xdef } result.ar_taxable_income ar_table_band_shift f>= ifelse

action_details.action_dsl: set result.ar_table_tax = the floor of (ar_high_base + (result.ar_taxable_income - ar_high_threshold) * ar_bracket_5_rate + 0.5)
action_details.action_postfix: ar_high_base result.ar_taxable_income ar_high_threshold f- ar_bracket_5_rate fmul f+ 0.5 f+ floor cvd /result.ar_table_tax xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set result.ar_table_tax = the floor of (result.ar_band_midpoint * ar_bracket_2_rate - ar_bracket_2_adjust + 0.5)
action_details.action_postfix: result.ar_band_midpoint ar_bracket_2_rate fmul ar_bracket_2_adjust f- 0.5 f+ floor cvd /result.ar_table_tax xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set result.ar_table_tax = the floor of (result.ar_band_midpoint * ar_bracket_3_rate - ar_bracket_3_adjust + 0.5)
action_details.action_postfix: result.ar_band_midpoint ar_bracket_3_rate fmul ar_bracket_3_adjust f- 0.5 f+ floor cvd /result.ar_table_tax xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set result.ar_table_tax = the floor of (result.ar_band_midpoint * ar_bracket_4_rate - ar_bracket_4_adjust + 0.5)
action_details.action_postfix: result.ar_band_midpoint ar_bracket_4_rate fmul ar_bracket_4_adjust f- 0.5 f+ floor cvd /result.ar_table_tax xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set result.ar_table_tax = the floor of (result.ar_band_midpoint * ar_bracket_5_rate - ar_bracket_5_adjust + 0.5)
action_details.action_postfix: result.ar_band_midpoint ar_bracket_5_rate fmul ar_bracket_5_adjust f- 0.5 f+ floor cvd /result.ar_table_tax xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set result.ar_table_tax = the floor of (result.ar_band_midpoint * ar_bracket_5_rate - (ar_phase_adjust_first - (the floor of ((result.ar_taxable_income - ar_bracket_5_limit - 1.0) / 100.0)) * ar_phase_adjust_step) + 0.5)
action_details.action_postfix: result.ar_band_midpoint ar_bracket_5_rate fmul ar_phase_adjust_first result.ar_taxable_income ar_bracket_5_limit f- 1.0 f- 100.0 fdiv floor ar_phase_adjust_step fmul f- f- 0.5 f+ floor cvd /result.ar_table_tax xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set result.ar_table_tax = the floor of (result.ar_band_midpoint * ar_bracket_5_rate - ar_top_adjust + 0.5)
action_details.action_postfix: result.ar_band_midpoint ar_bracket_5_rate fmul ar_top_adjust f- 0.5 f+ floor cvd /result.ar_table_tax xdef
